project: Automatos AI Platform — PRD-150 Auth Decoupling (Open Core)
description:
PRD-150: make auth pluggable behind one AuthProvider interface so the OSS edition runs locally with NO Clerk account, while SaaS keeps Clerk via a separate private package. This is a REFACTOR (move + delete, no shims) of a mature codebase — read automatos-ai/CLAUDE.md first, every iteration. Source PRD: docs/PRDS/PRD-150-AUTH-DECOUPLING-OPEN-CORE.md.

LOCKED DECISIONS (Gerard): full package-split of Clerk into a new private `automatos-saas/` package at REPO ROOT (sibling of orchestrator/), centralized identity resolution (ctx.user.id = internal users.id int), full-stack scope (backend + frontend edition gating).

VERIFIED GROUND TRUTH (trust this over the PRD text where they differ):
- Coupling: core/auth/clerk.py (ClerkAuth, 460 lines); core/auth/hybrid.py has the inline Clerk branch (lines ~683-776) + clerk-only helpers (_resolve_workspace_for_clerk_user, _provision_new_user_workspace, _user_is_workspace_member, _user_has_workspace_access, _has_pending_invitations, _get_pending_invitation_token); direct get_clerk_auth callers outside core/auth: ONLY api/team.py and services/workspace_purge.py. clerk_user_id leakage files: api/{blog,board_tasks,harness,marketplace,notifications,reports,team,tools,widget_marketplace,workflow_recipes,workspace_skills}.py + services/{coordinator_service,workspace_purge}.py + core/workspaces/permissions.py.
- users.id is Integer PK; users.clerk_user_id already nullable=True in the model. UserContext.id is currently Optional[str]; SDK/API-key paths set string sentinels ("sdk:<id>", "api_key") which MUST keep working — widen the annotation to int|str, do not break them.
- There are NO Clerk webhooks anywhere (no svix, no clerk webhook routes — verified). The "webhook" mentions in notifications/workspaces/team/workflow_recipes are workspace webhook_key / Composio triggers / notification destinations: all stay in core. PRD Q4 is resolved: nothing to relocate.
- orchestrator/ is NOT an installed package (no pyproject.toml) — the registry uses a built-in dict for core providers ({"local": LocalAuthProvider}) plus importlib.metadata.entry_points(group="automatos.auth_providers") for external packages. Do NOT package orchestrator itself.
- Migrations in this repo are STANDALONE (down_revision=None, e.g. prd142_wave5_drop_dead_tables.py). Author the new migration standalone. NEVER run `alembic upgrade head` (an un-applied Wave-5 DROP migration is Gerard's to apply); apply only the specific new revision to the LOCAL dev DB.
- envs/api.defaults already declares EDITION=oss and AUTH_PROVIDER=local; envs/frontend.defaults already names NEXT_PUBLIC_EDITION. Use exactly these names. Frontend default when NEXT_PUBLIC_EDITION is unset must be "saas" (prod safety).
- PRD-09 SECURITY INVARIANT: ak_pub_*/ak_srv_* SDK keys are accepted ONLY by require_task_context (board plane). Do NOT wire ak_* acceptance into get_request_context_hybrid — the comment block at hybrid.py:514-524 explains why. orchestrator/tests/test_board_sdk_auth.py (27 tests) must pass UNCHANGED.
- The ~108 files importing RequestContext/get_request_context_hybrid must not change signatures. If a story seems to require that, STOP (RALPH_BLOCKED), do not improvise.

TEST COMMANDS (real, verified): backend `cd orchestrator && python3 -m pytest --timeout=60 --timeout-method=thread -o faulthandler_timeout=90 -p no:cacheprovider -q` (local dev Postgres on 5432 is up; conftest gives transactional db_session); targeted files same command + paths. Frontend: `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit` and `cd frontend && npm run test` (vitest). SaaS package: `cd automatos-saas && python3 -m pytest tests -q` after `python3 -m pip install -e ./automatos-saas`.

OUT OF SCOPE: billing/SSO/extra providers; docker-compose changes (PRD-153 owns compose — do not touch docker-compose*.yml or infrastructure/); S3/mem0 decoupling (PRD-151/152); marketplace decoupling; frontend repo split; local multi-user login UI; applying migrations to prod; pushing/PRs; repo publication (secrets rotation + history scrub is a separate human checklist).

STACKING: this branch cuts from main and is FIRST in the overnight chain — PRD-151/152/153 branches stack on its tip. The tip must be green (full orchestrator suite + frontend tsc) after EVERY story commit. Order is interface-first, migrate-callers, delete-old-path-last. Commit per story behind green targeted tests; never commit with the full suite known-red.
